zh: 审批中心并入消息中心与焦点体验优化：将「需要你」待审批操作与「审批推送」抽屉合并进左下角消息中心并汇总角标计数；优化鼠标或触控关闭弹层后按 Esc 返回时的焦点框显示。
修复运维待办刷新自动弹窗与提示标签问题：修复空草稿点击或刷新 /#ops-drafts 时反复弹出「当前没有待确认消息」提示框的问题，无待办时自动清理残留 URL 哈希；补全 nav.dialog.info 中英文词条，解决弹窗标题上方显示 NAV.DIALOG.INFO 的问题。
TestFlight 审核队列主动置换与 Kindle 网关流量同步：升级 iOS 外测分发脚本，跨版本主动清理 G2 组中排队等待审核的旧构建并防止旧版本覆盖新版本；新增 kindle-traffic-sync 进程与单测，定期汇总 Debian 网关请求量与 5xx 异常至 Kindle 看板。
en: Integrated agent approval inbox into Message Center and refined focus outlines: merged 'Needs You' pending approvals and the approval push drawer into the bottom-left Message Center with unified badge counts, and suppressed spurious focus rings after pointer interactions.

Fixed ops drafts refresh popup and dialog eyebrow localization: cleared stale #ops-drafts hashes on page reload when no drafts are pending so empty notices no longer reappear on refresh, and added missing nav.dialog.info translations so dialogs no longer show raw NAV.DIALOG.INFO.

Proactive TestFlight review queue cleanup and Kindle gateway traffic sync: upgraded iOS external distribution to proactively unlink and expire superseded WAITING_FOR_REVIEW builds across versions, and added the kindle-traffic-sync PM2 worker and unit tests to summarize Debian gateway rates and 5xx errors for the Kindle dashboard.
